subject.title: [Feature]: Multi-role support in Chat UI for multi-agent workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable per-message sender identity contract across Gateway schemas, transcripts, live/history events, and Control UI rendering for multi-agent workflows, and what minimal metadata belongs in that contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API/storage/UI shape is a product and compatibility decision because it would become a public cross-surface contract.

options.title: Define additive sender metadata
options.body: Add a narrow sender identity object with sender id, kind, display name, source session/agent, and render hints, then thread it through chat.send, sessions.send/steer, transcript persistence, live/history events, and Control UI rendering.

options.title: Keep only narrow label fixes
options.body: Continue landing focused fixes such as requester prompt names and forwarded senderLabel fallbacks, accepting that the broader audit trail remains unresolved.

options.title: Defer multi-agent identity
options.body: Leave this issue open as product backlog until maintainers are ready to design the durable identity contract with migration and compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Define additive sender metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow sender identity object with sender id, kind, display name, source session/agent, and render hints, then thread it through chat.send, sessions.send/steer, transcript persistence, live/history events, and Control UI rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for inter-session provenance and prompt marking that this contract would extend.
